scope: Outcome-selected supplemental development experiment explicitly requested after auditing the original run. Do not replace original rewards or claim an independent clean benchmark. No prior outputs, solutions, official assertions or diagnostics are passed to the model. Inspect only operational metadata until all supplemental outputs are frozen. The other 55 tasks remain unopened.

model_policy.alias: Official guide checked 2026-11-01 maps the mutable deepseek-flash alias to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.

budget_policy: Original task-native timeouts/resources; 1800-second setup. Upstream sdk-minimal prompts, tools, compaction, retries, and generation defaults. No injected turn limit, internal time budget, or finalization reminders. Pi used OpenAI-compatible transport with 384000-token model metadata; this is not a matched-generation-budget causal harness comparison.

original_experiment.policy: Preserve original results. These six fresh attempts were separately authorized after the original audit; do not overwrite or choose a better score.

accounting_policy: Native rewards, exceptions and standard summaries are unchanged. Confirmed timeout outputs with completed official tests remain scoreable; setup failures, terminal provider transport failure and verifier dependency failures remain analytically null. Service-lifecycle failures are retained as failures of this measured SDK configuration. This is not a complete 34-task pass rate or a causal agent-quality comparison.

mixed_coverage.policy: Descriptive coverage using the 28 original accepted attempts plus exactly the six authorized new attempts. Outcome-selected mixed-date sample, not an independent benchmark or best-of-two score.

historical_comparison.caveats: The KV/PyPI losses have the confirmed SDK service-lifecycle caveat. The pipeline loss compares against a Pi pass exposed to public reference tests/solution. WAL passes here but was unscored in Pi and is not a paired gain; Pi sampler/WAL have invalid/unverified legacy boundaries. Different dates, mutable alias, Messages versus OpenAI-compatible endpoints, 256000 versus 384000 output ceilings, new dependency preparation/cache, and outcome selection prevent causal harness attribution.

usage.policy: Known SDK usage subtotals only. Interrupted requests and failed native retries can lack usage. Cache tokens are already included in input; do not add them again. No provider billing or price-derived cost is asserted.

timing.interpretation: Formal queue wall time includes setup, verification and pair barriers, but excludes earlier installation-only checks and transport probes. This supplement had no verifier retries or terminal API failures. Different dates and preparation prevent a controlled latency comparison.

initial.reason: PyTorch model recovery reached the 1800-second setup limit while downloading original verifier dependencies. After pair 2 completed, stop the controller before pair 3 and register verified PyPI wheel transport. No running trial was interrupted by this boundary stop.

launch.authorization: The maintainer requested rerunning the six unscored tasks on 2026-11-01. Prior explicit confirmation authorizes use of the existing DeepSeek provider credential without publishing it.
launch.credential_handling: Read the authorized local DeepSeek provider credential into the child environment only. No key is written to this record.
launch.output_policy: Freeze all six outputs before inspecting new model trajectories or hidden assertions.

preparation.transport_amendment: Use UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=http://127.0.0.1:18744/simple to forward the current original PyPI index, preserving versions, requirements, yanks, hashes and extra-index settings. Serve original wheels only after checking current PyPI release filename/size/SHA256/HTTPS origin and full downloaded bytes. Existing ranged downloader, cross-process file locks, and persistent public provenance log. Set UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600 for a cold wheel to finish verification before any body is served. Setup remains 1800 seconds; task-native agent/verifier limits and official scripts are unchanged. Original APT and uv/Python release transports remain identical. No model output or task is replayed automatically.
